newsitem.title: UK: BT up on Gle Eaux telecom stake talk.
newsitem.headline: BT up on Gle Eaux telecom stake talk.

text.p: Shares in telecommunications company British Telecom Plc pushed higher on Thursday on widespread reports it is poised to take a minority stake in the Cegetel telecoms unit of French utility Cie Generale des Eaux. BT shares were up 1-1/2p at 364p by 0716 GMT in a generally steady market. Over 55,000 shares had changed hands.
Sources told Reuters that BT would take a minority stake in Cegetel. BT said it planned a news conference in London at 0930 GMT to make an "announcement with international dimension."

Golob said it had looked previously as if Generale des Eaux had favoured Unisource, a consortium linked with AT&T of the U.S. He called it strategically interesting that Germany's Mannesmann AG, which BT said would be a partner in Cegetel, was now linked to the British company.
